summary: Describes a mechanism to support the multicast needs of Layer 3 protocols over ATM networks, and applies it to IP multicasting. It addresses how a connection-oriented network can deliver one-to-many traffic.

eli5.summary: ATM normally connects two phones at a time. This note shows how to make it work like a conference call so one speaker reaches many listeners.
